title: Changing the date range reloads the rows; a Custom range is capped at 366 days
preconds: 1. You are on the Technician Utilization report with rows loaded.
steps:
1. Change the date range with the report's date-range picker (e.g. to Last Month).
2. Choose a Custom range within 366 days (start to end).
3. Try a Custom range wider than 366 days.
expected:
1. Each range change reloads the report's rows for the new range.
2. A valid Custom range applies normally.
3. A Custom span wider than 366 days (matching the largest preset) is rejected - it cannot be applied.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Technician Utilization report specification version 9 (S1-R4, S1-R5), read on 17 August 2026.
Last checked against build v3.8-bd246fd on 8/18/2026.
